request.deadline: 2026 funding period / 12 months; exact start and end dates not stated in document

Maintenance of supporting interoperability libraries and cardano-hw-cli
Support for integration paths involving externally maintained components where shared hardware-wallet flows intersect

request.recipient: Intersect on behalf of the vendor, with withdrawal directed to the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address.
request.what: Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 for Cardano hardware-wallet support, including Ledger and Trezor compatibility updates, interoperability libraries and cardano-hw-cli maintenance, developer support, externally maintained shared hardware-wallet flow support, and vendor-required product or security audits.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ada, consisting of 1,272,777 ada for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ada for an Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The requested funding is for 12 months of production maintenance of Cardano hardware-wallet support rather than creation of a new wallet product.

The maintained scope includes Ledger and Trezor compatibility updates, supporting interoperability libraries, cardano-hw-cli, developer support, shared hardware-wallet integration paths, and vendor-required audits triggered by firmware or app changes.
The proposal asserts that continuous hardware-wallet maintenance is needed to prevent users and integrators from losing secure access when Cardano, Ledger, or Trezor introduce breaking changes.
The proposal asserts that its scope does not duplicate broader core-node, ledger, or general infrastructure maintenance budgets.

The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation, final audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal states that the withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

Intersect will administer the withdrawn funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts using a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract, with listed stake and payment addresses.
The document states that an Oversight Committee of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl will provide checks and balances over specified smart-contract actions.
The document provides prior treasury funding disclosures and Project Catalyst links related to hardware wallets, Ledger app work, Plutus enhancement, security, and developer ecosystem projects.

summary: The anchor describes a 1,310,960 ada treasury withdrawal for 12 months of Cardano hardware-wallet maintenance, with a detailed high-level scope, budget split, Intersect process references, NCL compliance assertion, smart-contract administration addresses, and oversight structure, but without granular vendor identity, dated milestones, or detailed cost basis in the supplied text.
